deck: It costs £15,000 a month to run Emmanuel. We raise all of it ourselves, locally — it doesn't come from the Government or the Church of England.
headline: Every gift keeps the doors open.

children.text: While we hold fundraising events and rent out the church, one of the foundations of our finances is the tremendous support we receive from our congregation through regular donations.
